title: cheilanthes incana
intro: Cheilanthes incana, commonly known as the Frosty Lip Fern, is a species of fern native to the mountainous regions of the Western United States. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. Cheilanthes incana has been traditionally used for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its health benefits, including the relief of digestive issues and skin irritations. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, which include antioxidant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
